title: The GTA 6 Gator Scene Happens in Real Florida
lines: In the GTA 6 trailer, an alligator walks right into a store.
Sounds crazy? In Florida, it's closer to real life than you think.
Florida has about one point three million wild alligators.
They turn up in pools, garages, even on golf courses.
On land, a gator can sprint around eleven miles an hour, but only in short bursts.
So if it were you, forget the zigzag myth. Just run straight away.
And never feed one. It's illegal in Florida, because fed gators lose their fear of people.
GTA 6 drops November nineteenth. Follow for more!
caption:
GTA 6 is set in a Florida-inspired state, and the gator in the trailer isn't that far from reality 🐊 Florida has about 1.3 million wild alligators. If one chases you: no zigzag, just run straight away. Feeding them is illegal.

Fan-made explainer, not affiliated with Rockstar Games. Sources: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission, University of Florida IFAS.
